title: RuntimeConventions
description: Structured execution conventions and constraints for host agent runtimes.

max_subagent_depth.description: Maximum permitted subagent recursion depth (default 1 for parent-owned dispatch).

supported_isolation_modes.description: Supported workspace isolation modes (e.g. worktree, none, branch, share).

default_model.description: Default model slug or role inherited by spawned subagents.

allowed_spawn_fields.description: Allowed field names on the model-facing subagent spawn primitive.

forbidden_spawn_fields.description: Forbidden field names on the model-facing subagent spawn primitive.

wire_aliases.description: Mapping from host wire or internal alias to canonical TUI tool identifier.
